svg.title: State and Cost, environment by environment
svg.desc: Static: for each environment, the State type bound into SearchEnvironment<State, Cost>, one example state, one GetNeighbors entry (next state, step cost) and what makes two states equal. Cost is the same everywhere.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: SingleSourceSearch<State, Cost, Env>(source: State, init_cost: Cost, env: Env&)

g.text: Cost = Interval::Duration = std::chrono::system_clock::duration (an integer tick count; nanoseconds with GCC on Linux)

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: g(state) = init_cost (0) + sum of step costs along the path; f = g + GetHeuristic(state) = g, because every heuristic here is 0

g.text: State and Cost, environment by environment

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The engine is the same for all four. What changes is the State it stores in its open set and predecessor map, and how the environment prices a step. Values are examples on the Pecos layout.
